Commentary.Commentary: Right then, an expected result in the first semi-final and India Women will now be waiting for the winner of the game between Pakistan Women and Sri Lanka Women. That match will begin shortly at 1 pm IST (7.30 am GMT). Cheers!

Shafali Verma is picked for the Player of the Match award. She scored 42 runs off 28 balls and also took a wicket. The Indian opener says that she is happy with her performance and says that the wicket was good to bat on. Tells that she formed good partnerships with Smriti Mandhana and Jemimah Rodrigues and they are looking to work on partnerships. Hopes that the weather will be good for the final and adds that things are going well now for her but hopes to improve further.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the captain of India Women, says that they batted very well against a good bowling attack of Thailand and the partnerships they got helped them to get a decent total on the board. Tells that she is happy with her performance and adds that one gets confidence by getting runs after a break. Mentions that Deepti Sharma can bowl in any situation in the game and she is a match-winner for them. Says that they are ready to play against any team in the final and they are looking forward to it.

Naruemol Chaiwai, the skipper of Thailand Women, says that it was a good experience for them to play in this tournament. Mentions that they are a talented side and getting more exposure will help them. Feels that they have to show more intent and enjoy themselves a bit more.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

As expected, the bowling of India Women proved to be too hot to handle for Thailand Women. Deepti Sharma struck thrice to peg them back and Thailand never recovered.​ Naruemol Chaiwai and Nattaya Boochatham did apply themselves for a short while but that only delayed the inevitable.

Earlier, India Women fared decently with the bat to post a good total on the board on a slowish surface. It could have been even more had Thailand Women not pulled things back at the death. Credit to them for conceding just one boundary in the last five overs and restricting India Women under 150. That said, the Thai batting once again let them down and they lost this game comprehensively.

Yet another thumping win for India Women as they storm into the final and keep their cent per cent record of playing in all Women's Asia Cup finals. Thailand Women were never in the game, right from the start and it was once again a meek surrender with the bat from them. Nevertheless, reaching this stage of the tournament will do their confidence a world of good.

Dot to end proceedings! Verma fires a yorker outside off. Thipatcha Putthawong fails to dig it out and misses. India clinch this game comfortably by 74 runs and have booked their place in the final of the Women's Asia Cup 2022!
Fires it on leg. Nanthita Boonsukham tries to sweep it but misses. The ball goes off the pads towards short fine leg and a leg bye is taken.
Nanthita Boonsukham is in next.

OUT! RUN OUT! This is tossed up on off. Thipatcha Putthawong drives it to mid on and sets off for a single. Deepti Sharma there picks up the ball quickly and fires a direct hit at the batter's end. There is an appeal for a run out and the replays confirm that Onnicha Kamchomphu is short of her crease.
Tossed up, on off. Onnicha Kamchomphu drives it to long off for a single.
Tossed up on off. Onnicha Kamchomphu drives it to straight to the fielder.
A flatter one on off. Onnicha Kamchomphu blocks it out.

Oh...nearly a hat-trick! This is a loopy delivery on off. Onnicha Kamchomphu plays it a tad early and ends up looping it up in the air just over and to the left of the bowler. She tries to catch it but it goes over. Single taken.
Onnicha Kamchomphu to face the hat-trick ball. Harmanpreet Kaur has opted for an umbrella field.

OUT! BOWLED! Two in two now and Rajeshwari Gayakwad is on a hat-trick! This is again an arm delivery, fired on off. Phannita Maya goes back to play it but is quite late and ends up missing it completely. The ball deflects off the pads and disturbs the stumps. India Women are enjoying themselves out in the middle now.
Phannita Maya is the number 9 batter for Thailand Women.

OUT! LBW! This is clever bowling from Rajeshwari Gayakwad and Thailand Women lose their seventh. After tossing up quite a few deliveries, she bowls an arm ball that just skids off the surface. On middle and Naruemol Chaiwai, who tries to clip it, misses. There is an appeal as the ball hits her back pad and the umpire raises the finger.
Tossed up, outside off. Naruemol Chaiwai tries to slog-sweep it but misses.
Pushed quicker and on off. Naruemol Chaiwai plays it back to the bowler.
This is tossed up, outside off. Naruemol Chaiwai tries to drive it but misses.
Thipatcha Putthawong comes to bat next. Also, Rajeshwari Gayakwad is back into the attack.

OUT! STUMPED! A loopy delivery outside off to tempt the batter, Rosenan Kanoh gets lured into the shot as she advances down the track. Swings her bat at it but fails to connect. Richa Ghosh does the rest neatly.
Commentary.Howout: st Richa Ghosh b Shafali Verma

Commentary.Commentary: A flatter delivery on off. Rosenan Kanoh blocks it out.
FOUR! Good shot! Tossed up, outside off. Rosenan Kanoh gets to the pitch of the ball and powers it wide of mid off for a boundary.
Another single to long on as she drives this full delivery off the middle of her blade.
Tossed up on middle. Rosenan Kanoh drives it to long on for a single.
WIDE! Fuller and down the leg side. Rosenan Kanoh tries to clip it but misses.
On the shorter side, around off. Naruemol Chaiwai tries to cut it but gets the inside edge that goes past stumps towards short fine leg. Single taken.

OUT! LBW! Sneh Rana gets her first wicket and breaks this pretty decent partnership for Thailand Women. Rana loops it up in the air on middle angling from 'round the wicket. Nattaya Boochatham tries to sweep it but ends up playing inside the line of the ball. She misses and gets hit on the pads and is given out after an appeal. The batter is surprised but she has to walk back.
Rosenan Kanoh is in next. Also, Shafali Verma comes on to bowl.
Radha Yadav is going off the field. It seems she has hurt her hands.
WIDE! Rana fires it but spills it down the leg side. Nattaya Boochatham tries to sweep it but misses.
Loopy delivery on off. Nattaya Boochatham blocks it off the front foot.
They are at least showing some intent now. Fuller delivery on off. Naruemol Chaiwai sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish length and outside off. Naruemol Chaiwai cuts it through point for a couple.
WIDE! Pushed quicker and way outside off. Naruemol Chaiwai leaves it.
Again a sweep shot as this is angled into leg. Single taken as the ball goes a bit aerially towards deep square leg.
Slower through the air, on off. Naruemol Chaiwai slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pushed quicker and flatter, around off. Nattaya Boochatham tries to sweep it but misses and gets hit on the pads.

FOUR! Nicely played, finally a boundary for Thailand Women! This one is tossed up, around off. Nattaya Boochatham uses her feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and plays an inside-out shot over extra cover for a boundary.
There is a light drizzle in the air and the groundsmen are getting ready.
Just a single! On the shorter side, on middle. Naruemol Chaiwai clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fires it full and on off. Nattaya Boochatham sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Goes fuller and on off. Nattaya Boochatham drives it a bit uppishly towards mid off.
Radha Yadav continues to keep it tight. She bowls it quicker on off. Nattaya Boochatham cuts it to the point fielder.
Quicker and flatter on middle, defended down on the leg side.
And again! Spinning in sharply from around off, Chaiwai attempts to sweep but misses. This time it flies over the leg pole.
Turn and bounce from around off, Naruemol Chaiwai tries to sweep but misses. It goes over the off pole.
Turning in from outside off, Chaiwai hangs on the back foot and plays late. Finds point.
Slower one, short and on off, Chaiwai cuts from the back foot but finds the cover fielder.
Fires in a full ball around off, Nattaya slogs it over mid-wicket for a single. 50 comes up!
Another aerial shot, this time from Nattaya. She comes forward to a full ball and lofts it wide of mid off. Collects one run.
Flatter and fuller on middle, Chaiwai lofts it over wide mid on and picks a single.
Goes down and across to a full ball and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up around off, Naruemol Chaiwai slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a run. Another no ball for overstepping. Free Hit loading...
Loopy and full outside off, Nattaya Boochatham brings out the sweep shot and sends it to deep square leg for a run.
Slower one, full and around off, the batter comes down the track to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads, again.
A half-tracker on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Swing and a miss! Floated one, full and around off, Nattaya Boochatham advances down the track to heave it over the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Quicker and flatter on off, defended to the off side.
Fullish and on middle, Chaiwai sweeps it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and on off, tapped down to backward point.
Fuller and outside off, driven to extra cover.
Goes down and sweeps it on the leg side for a run.

Stumped off a Free Hit! Slower one, full and drifting in on middle, Naruemol Chaiwai walks forward to heave it over the leg side but the ball spins past her blade. Richa Ghosh takes the bails off just for formality.
Short again, around off, pulled to deep square leg for a run. Another no ball. Another Free Hit coming...
Short and wide outside off, cut to backward point.
Too full and on middle, it's swept to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter arm ball on middle, Chaiwai goes back and punches it to covers.
Shortish on off, played down to point. Radha has overstepped, Free Hit coming up...
Skidding in from around off, cramping the batter for room. Naruemol Chaiwai is beaten on the inside edge.
Fuller and on middle, flicked over square leg for a run.
Beautiful yorker, just outside off, once again the Thai skipper tries to play the slog sweep but gets beaten comprehensively.
Play and a miss! Slower through the air, full and outside off, Chaiwai tries to slog but misses.
Spinning away from around off, Nattaya goes down and sweeps it to long leg for a run.
Quicker and fuller on middle, it's pushed down to mid on.
Sharp turn from outside off, Nattaya Boochatham leans forward to push inside the line but misses.
Slightly short and on off, turning in, Naruemol Chaiwai pulls it wide of mid-wicket for a single.

Drinks break. Nothing much to say here as the scorecard itself is telling the entire story. Thailand Women are nowhere in this game, their chase has not been up to the mark and they are just going through the motions.
Yadav bowls it fuller and on middle. Naruemol Chaiwai sweeps it to deep square leg for just a single again. 116 more needed from 60 balls!
Beaten! Touch shorter and around off. Turns a bit after pitching and Naruemol Chaiwai misses her cut shot.
Pushes it quicker and flatter on off. Naruemol Chaiwai blocks it out.
Shorter in length and outside off. Nattaya Boochatham cuts it to deep point for a single.
They are getting singles and doubles regularly now. Another sweep as this one is angled into middle. Naruemol Chaiwai hits it to deep square leg for a single.
Floated up on off. Naruemol Chaiwai sweeps it to deep square leg for a couple.
Radha Yadav is into the attack now.
Slower through the air and on off. Nattaya Boochatham drives it to covers. 121 needed now from 66 balls. Tough for Thailand Women!
Pushed quicker on off. Nattaya Boochatham punches it towards the off side off the back foot.
Tad short again on middle. Nattaya Boochatham clips it to deep backward square leg for a couple.

Shorter in length and outside off. Nattaya Boochatham tries to cut it but gets an outside edge. The ball flies wide of the first slip fielder and the batters take two as the fielder cuts it off in the deep.
Slower through the air, on off. Naruemol Chaiwai opens the face of her blade and guides it towards backward point for a single.
Bowls it on off and flatter. Nattaya Boochatham drags it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Change in bowling as Deepti Sharma has bowled out. In comes Sneh Rana...
A fullish delivery on leg. Nattaya Boochatham clips it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Nattaya Boochatham is the new batter.

OUT! KNOCKED HER OVER! This is a yorker from Renuka Singh on off. Chanida Sutthiruang has no answers for it as she fails to get her bat down in time. The ball knocks over the off pole and Thailand Women lose their fourth.
Angling into middle and fuller. Naruemol Chaiwai flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Singh with a fullish delivery outside off. Chanida Sutthiruang chases it and gets a single to deep backward point.
A single now! Bowls it fuller and on middle. Naruemol Chaiwai clips it wide of mid on for a single.
A fullish delivery, outside off. Naruemol Chaiwai drives it to covers. Thailand are going nowhere in this chase.
A wicket maiden. Slower through the air, on off. Chanida Sutthiruang drives it straight to mid off. 4-1-7-3 - Deepti Sharma is done with her exceptional spell.
Loopy and fuller on middle. Chanida Sutthiruang gently clips it towards the leg side.
Looks like the Thai girls have decided that they would try to just play out Deepti here. This is a tossed-up delivery on off. Chanida Sutthiruang decides to block it.
Again a dot! Loopy delivery again on off. Chanida Sutthiruang pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated up, on off. Chanida Sutthiruang drives it to covers.
Chanida Sutthiruang walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Thailand Women lose another and Deepti Sharma gets her third wicket. This is lovely bowling, nicely tossed up, outside off. Sornnarin Tippoch tries to drive it but only manages to get an outside edge. Richa Ghosh, behind the stumps, takes a sharp catch and India Women are bossing this game now.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: The sun is currently out but we can see dark clouds slowly building around the stadium. They look scary. Anyway, we have got the number of overs done in the second innings to have a result.
Defensive shot again! At the end of Powerplay, Thailand Women are 18 for two. A good-length delivery on off. Naruemol Chaiwai blocks it off the front foot. 131 needed now from 84 balls!
Single this time. On a length and around off. Sornnarin Tippoch guides it to the right of the point fielder for a single.
Bit fuller and on off. Sornnarin Tippoch drives it straight to the short cover fielder.
Beaten! Serves a good-length delivery, outside off. It is angled across the batter and Sornnarin Tippoch who tries to drive it gets beaten on the outside edge.
A fullish delivery on off. Sornnarin Tippoch drives it to the short cover fielder.
Starts off with a fuller delivery on middle. Naruemol Chaiwai defends it towards the leg side and takes a single. There is a collision between the bowler and the non-striker but nothing serious.
Time for some pace now. Renuka Singh is into the attack.
Flatter slider around off, Sornnarin Tippoch goes back and cuts but finds the point fielder.
Grip and turn outside off, Sornnarin Tippoch tries to cut but misses.
Quicker one, it's fired down the leg side, and the batter tries to work it around but misses. It goes off Sornnarin Tippoch's pads to fine leg and they get two leg byes.
Turning away from outside off, Sornnarin Tippoch allows it through to the keeper.
FOUR! A good start for Sornnarin Tippoch! Short in length outside off, turning away, Tippoch rocks back and whacks it past the point fielder for a boundary.
Sornnarin Tippoch walks out to the middle now.

OUT! TAKEN! A well-judged catch in the deep. Loopy delivery, full and around off and it spins back in with some extra lift. Natthakan Chantham kneels down to play the slog sweep but gets a top edge. It flies down to deep mid-wicket where Pooja Vastrakar runs across to her left and takes a superb catch. 139 needed off 95 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Pooja Vastrakar b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Arm ball around middle, it's tucked to square leg for a single.
Aerial but safe! Thailand Women don't want to die wondering. Natthakan Chantham takes her chance and plays a mistimed lofted shot over mid off. Gets two runs.
Again it's full, around off, Chantham drills it back and Rajeshwari Gayakwad uses her right leg to make the stop.
Fuller and on off, driven back to the bowler.
Loopy delivery, around off, Natthakan Chantham walks forward and pushes it to covers. Loses her balance a bit in the process.
Flighted and on off, Natthakan Chantham prods forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
The batter has just watchfully blocked this out.
Naruemol Chaiwai walks out at number 3!

OUT! CAUGHT! Shafali Verma redeems herself. Flighted delivery, full and turning in from around off, Nannapat Koncharoenkai goes down to sweep but fails to keep it down. It goes flat and quick to Shafali Verma at square leg who takes the catch safely on this occasion. Thailand Women lose their first wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Shafali Verma b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Uses the spin and works it on the leg side but finds square leg.

Shafali Verma drops a dolly! Floated and full, around off, Natthakan Chantham tries to slog-sweep but it takes the top edge and balloons towards square leg. Richa Ghosh goes for it and Shafali Verma perhaps gets put off by the keeper. Drops a sitter. The batters cross.
Wide! Turning down the leg side, Natthakan Chantham tries to flick but misses.
Flatter and on off, punched down on the pitch.

Dropped! A very tough catch. Deepti Sharma gets this one to turn in sharply from around off, Natthakan Chantham walks forward to flick but gets a thin inside edge. Richa Ghosh tries her best but it brushes her left glove and slips away.
Around leg, helped to square leg. Dot ball to end the over.
Beauty! Drift and turn there. It lands outside off and spins away, Nannapat Koncharoenkai sticks back to play on the leg side but it takes the leading edge and drops in front of the bowler.
Drags her length short and lands it on off, Nannapat goes back to cut but finds the fielder at cover-point.
A touch flatter and shorter on middle, it's worked to square leg.
FOUR! First of the chase. Too full in length, around leg, Nannapat Koncharoenkai goes down on one knee and sweeps it superbly behind square leg for a boundary.
Slower through the air, full and on middle, the batter defends it off the inner half to the on side.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad to start from the other end.
Short and on off, spinning in, Natthakan Chantham goes on the back foot and cuts it to point. A tidy start from Deepti.
Fuller again, around off, this time the batter advances down the track but plays it towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, Chantham defends it off the front foot.

Beats the stumps by a whisker. Turn and bounce there for Deepti Sharma. She lands it on a fuller length around off, Natthakan Chantham tries to defend but it beats the inside edge and flies over the stumps.
Sharma gives it a good toss and lands it full around off, Nannapat Koncharoenkai advances down the track and knocks it to long on for a run.
Sharma serves a flighted delivery, full and on off, Nannapat Koncharoenkai defends it to the off side.
